title: a-decision-is-a-question-bound-to-its-ticket-and-answered-in-the-inbox
author: CC
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the care of the code; the question store is a record of truth in the commons (jurisdiction: questions/*.json) and the tool cairn/tools/question has users, not owners (Law 6).
intention: A decision Akien has to make is asked as a QUESTION bound to the ticket or intention that needs it — raised at /sorted (and /intent), answered in words, standing in his inbox as an open question until it is, and looping (an answer that bears more questions bears them as open questions on the same ticket) until the ticket carries every answer its build needs; the separate ruling packet, its store-forward, and its Stop-hook nag retire.
why: Law 1 (one intake for 'Akien decides X' instead of two — the ruling packet and the review queue — with the decision recorded once, beside the work that needed it, never re-derived); Law 5 (the decision shares the ticket's address instead of a parallel store the reader has to correlate back — the same finding that retired adjudications on 2026-08-28: 'the artifact IS the review surface'); Law 9 (what waits at his gate is what only his head can settle — a question is that gate's native shape, and the loop is how translation fidelity is reached); Law 4 (the loop's exit condition is a crossing gate, not a paragraph).
how: One tool, cairn/tools/question, the door for the existing open lane (CairnCommons/questions/open-*.json, ruled 2026-08-01 'edges become open questions'; the operator inbox already reads it — read_questions in cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py, empty since 2026-08-27). Verbs: open (CC or a skill door raises a question against a ticket id — the record carries ticket, question, why_it_blocks, raised_by), answer (his words verbatim, answered_by from the caller's cgroup class, plus any follow-up questions the answer bears, each opened born_of the answered one), and list. The record is the decision: the ticket's `questions` field lists its question ids and the answers are read from the store, never copied. /sorted grows a `questions` packet field (the spec choices the caster cannot settle — today these hide inside builder_check and in chat) and the filing step opens each one. The emit chokepoint gains buildme_has_no_open_questions: TICKETME -> BUILDME refuses while any unresolved open question cites the ticket — 'until you have all the answers you need' as physics, not discipline. Then the retirement: `cairn ruling open` refuses with a pointer to `cairn question`, bin/cmd/ruling --hook leaves .claude/settings.json's Stop hooks, the /ruled skill retires, CLAUDE.md's ruling IOU and residue lines say so, the six skills that cite `cairn ruling open` cite the question door, the two build_inspector sieves that accept 'a ruling' as the same-act evidence (constraint_enforcement_holds, every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility) accept an answered question by id as well. CairnCommons/decisions/ stays as read-only record; nothing rewrites it.
falsifier: DONE when: (1) `cairn question open --ticket <id> "<q>"` writes open-<qid>.json through the artifact door and the operator inbox lists it under that ticket; (2) `cairn question answer <qid> "<words>" [--follow-up "<q>"...]` resolves it, journals the caller class, and each follow-up is a new open question born_of it; (3) a TICKETME ticket with one unresolved question is REFUSED at BUILDME by the emit chokepoint (buildme_has_no_open_questions) and crosses once answered — a proof a hollow build could not pass (revert the gate, the crossing goes through, the tooth reds); (4) `cairn ruling open` exits non-zero pointing at `cairn question`, `ruling --hook` is gone from the Stop hooks, zero skills tell CC to open a ruling; (5) constraint_enforcement_holds and every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility accept an answered question id as same-act evidence and still red a cite of neither. Horizon: one build. WRONG INTENT if a decision arrives that no ticket or intention can bind — then standalone decisions were a real class and decisions/ reopens as an intake.
traces_to: Law 1 (one intake for 'Akien decides X' instead of two — the ruling packet and the review queue — with the decision recorded once, beside the work that needed it, never re-derived); Law 5 (the decision shares the ticket's address instead of a parallel store the reader has to correlate back — the same finding that retired adjudications on 2026-08-28: 'the artifact IS the review surface'); Law 9 (what waits at his gate is what only his head can settle — a question is that gate's native shape, and the loop is how translation fidelity is reached); Law 4 (the loop's exit condition is a crossing gate, not a paragraph).

watchme.trigger: every BUILDME crossing attempt through the emit chokepoint, and every `cairn question answer` — the door pokes the probe after the act; no poller.
watchme.enough: 20 tickets have crossed to BUILDME after this gate exists with ZERO crossings recorded while an unresolved question cited the ticket, AND at least 5 questions answered with follow-ups (the loop went around at least once in the wild) — or ONE crossing that went through with an open question standing, which is the finding and the WRONG-INTENT clause.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier: the crossings counted, the open-question count at each, the follow-up depth histogram, and every answer's caller class.
watchme.nexus: the what-Akien-decides tree — the same open lane the frontier projector (cairn/tools/edges) compiles; this probe is the first reader that measures the lane's THROUGHPUT rather than its contents.
watchme.consumer: Akien, and the counting learning block (5a4ec289bf15) once it reads who answers what.

gates_bound: code-seam gate-set: BUILDME rides the intent berth and the sorted berth (buildme_rides_the_intent, buildme_rides_the_sorted) — AND, once this ticket is built, rides its own new gate buildme_has_no_open_questions, which this ticket is the first to be measured by (its four questions must be answered before it crosses; if they are not, the gate it builds refuses the ticket that built it — the self-reference tooth). PROVEME: proofs sealed green with current fingerprint, hollow reading over every writes_to file, proof_coverage naming a tooth per falsifier clause. PROVED: verdict artifact against the falsifier. Feeds back to origin on failure.
children: none, because the seam is one tool with one gate and one retirement list, all in one build; the follow-on that is NOT this ticket is askscan's fate, held as question (4) rather than a child.
depends_on: 30531f6e1c5d (PROVED) — the question store is written through the artifact door.
